name: kaleidoscope-monorepo
description: Kaleidoscope - Responsive design preview tool for Claude Code

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd mosaic-client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../mcp-server && npm install && cd ../examples/sample-site && npm install && cd ../auth-demo && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:mcp
scripts.check: npm run check:client && npm run check:server && npm run check:mcp
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:client && npm run test:unit:server
scripts.storyboard: npx cross-env KALEIDOSCOPE_STORYBOARD=1 PLAYWRIGHT_SAMPLE_SITE_PORT=5174 playwright test tests/e2e/storyboard.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit:client && cd server && npx tsx --test utils/*.test.ts services/find-chromium.test.ts services/proxy.service.test.ts services/tunnel.service.test.ts routes/validation.integration.test.ts routes/watcher.routes.test.ts routes/inspect.integration.test.ts
